subject: Risk & Compliance
title: How Nations Weaponize Economics
description: Learn How Nations Weaponize Economics in one minute.

hook.text: The US freezes Russia's central bank reserves. $300 billion becomes inaccessible overnight. Money is a weapon.

buildup.text: Economic statecraft uses trade, finance, and technology as tools of geopolitical power and coercion.

discovery.text: The US dollar's reserve status gives America unique power to impose financial sanctions on any country or entity.

twist.text: Weaponizing economics has consequences. Countries now actively seek alternatives to dollar dependence.

climax.text: Every economic weapon creates counter-strategies. Today's advantage becomes tomorrow's vulnerability.

punchline.text: $300 billion frozen overnight. The dollar is a weapon.

quiz.question: Why can the US impose powerful financial sanctions?
options: The dollar's status as the world's reserve currency
The US has the largest military
